scale.source: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1) s 103(1) as restored by P.L. 2025-34: end of the 8 % band ("eight percent (8%) upon the first $10,400")
scale.basis: Income Tax Act 1989 (48 MIRC Ch. 1) s 103(1) as restored by P.L. 2025-34: end of the 8 % band ("eight percent (8%) upon the first $10,400"). A statutory threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act 1989 (wages and salary tax)' confirmed and dated: in 2025 the wage tax changed twice: 8 %/12 %/16 % ($15,600/$26,000 a year, prorated per pay period) from P.L. 2024-14, back to 8 % on the first $10,400 and 12 % above from 1 October 2025 (P.L. 2025-34); all-or-nothing exemption at $8,320 a year ($693.33 a month); 5 % for US contractor personnel; social security 8 % employee on covered earnings.
